gen-gf-phudu-gf-chakra-petch: Chakra Petch has round letters that look cupped rather than clenched, a plain sans with a contemporary lean. And Phudu up top is the loud one, bold and distinctive, with openings at the end of every curve.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Modern in manner, Chiron Hei HK pulls its c wide open like a bracelet slipped apart. Phudu stays brisk and pen-flat above it, with no brush-style swell, and its heading voice is the louder of the two.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-commissioner: Commissioner reads smoothly, with no clogged curves and every stroke drawn at one thickness. Commissioner is the part to size up or down as the text needs, while Phudu, bold and distinctive, keeps its own scale.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-didact-gothic: Didact Gothic never snags on a closed-up bowl, and each stroke carries the same visual weight. Didact Gothic gives Phudu, with its ballpoint-plain line and open curve endings, a modern, quiet neighbor to stand against.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-dotgothic16: Approachable and tidy, DotGothic16 sends wide channels into each counter. Phudu is best at making a bold, distinctive statement, while DotGothic16 does its best work as the tube-thick plain sans carrying the words beneath.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-doto: Marker-bold up top, spacious below. Phudu holds a constant, pen-flat line with open curve endings, while Doto gives every glyph wide margins and generous round mouths. They feel like a shout beside a whisper.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-el-messiri: Phudu draws everything with one fixed nib, so curves end in generous openings and never swell. And El Messiri, a sans with a middling thick-thin difference and a wide slot in its c, gives that bold heading a more modulated partner.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-electrolize: Chunky marker lines meet mechanical jaws. Phudu ignores stroke direction entirely, bold and distinctive, while Electrolize, a sans-serif with a c like a pair of pliers, feels modern and a bit more engineered beside it.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-elms-sans: Phudu leads with bold, distinctive letters, each curve ending in a generous opening and a ballpoint's plain line. Elms Sans follows with that same pressure-free stroke but a modern, quieter manner, a gap showing clearly in each s.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-encode-sans: Phudu keeps every curve at one weight, with no shift along the bend, and its endings open generously. Encode Sans feels cleaner and cooler beside it.
